quotes.speaker: Malika Andrews
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's impressive performance in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I've been so impressed with Dylan Harper this series. He's playing way beyond his years here.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: I've been so impressed with Dylan Harper this series. He's playing way beyond his years here. Jeremy, I know he stood out to you as well.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: Absolutely. He is poised, he's ready for the moment.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's development and his mother's influence
quotes.excerpt: He gives a lot of credit to his mother, who actually immigrated from the Philippines to America.
quotes.quote: He gives a lot of credit to his mother, who actually immigrated from the Philippines to America. She ended up playing D1 basketball and was his primary coach from elementary school to high school. You can tell he's been around the game.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin's personal struggle with student loans and financial sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: When I graduated from college, I had so many loans I had borrowed from the bank.
quotes.quote: When I graduated from college, I had so many loans I had borrowed from the bank, the house, Harvard, and everything. I wasn't eating until I was full while preparing for the NBA draft to try to save money. My mom never told me. She just called me one day and said, 'You have to eat until you're full. I found some money somewhere.' And I didn't ask where. She told me seven or eight years later that was all I had left in my 401k, her retirement.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Immigrant parents sacrificing their dreams for their children
quotes.excerpt: We had to give up our dreams so our children could chase theirs.
quotes.quote: My mom often talked about it as an immigrant mother: we had to give up our dreams so our children could chase theirs. I love the story of Harper and his mother, and he describes his mother as his rock.
